suggested_analysis.endpoint_rule: First timestamp at or after start+h; log actual horizon; no extrapolation; missing/end-of-sequence cases retained.
suggested_analysis.aggregation: Disjoint1second bins anchored at sequence start; median,P90,valid count,missing; final partial bin separately reported.
suggested_analysis.scale: One fixed existing evaluation scale per method across all windows; intervention branches share the scale/alignment set before their divergence, no independent fit of branch outcomes.
suggested_analysis.first_event: Chronologically earliest qualifying interval; preserve complete set and zero events; do not pick worst frame as causal anchor.
suggested_analysis.persistence_proposal: For same-reference displacement on preregistered comparable visible-point domain, median per frame then median across each of two subsequent complete1second bins exceeds predeclared consumer tau. Undefined comparison or insufficient frozen coverage=>NA.
suggested_analysis.causal_timing: Interval is only an exploratory candidate. At write step k the archived current output precedes S/M commit; evaluate commit effects from k+1. Complete state/no-intervention compatibility and full-frame skip control needed.
suggested_analysis.independence: Overlapping windows, pixels and a single trajectory are not independent scene confirmations.

thresholds.name: five-second interval / one-second bins / P90 / two-bin persistence / earliest interval
thresholds.meaning: must be fixed before reading new scores if used prospectively

thresholds.name: one actual consumer output pixel
thresholds.meaning: must be justified against output resolution, common visibility, calibration and scoring uncertainty; no universal threshold claim

thresholds.name: actual merge/z-buffer/reference-selection boundaries
thresholds.meaning: measure consumer-relevant changes; a boundary crossing may be correct and is not itself quality degradation

consumer_measures.pose_sensitivity: Small-angle near-axis pinhole estimates f*transverse_translation_error/Z and f*rotation_error_radians are illustrative; use exact K/projection for actual evaluation, not a universal upper bound.
consumer_measures.depth_sensitivity: For a translated view with baseline B, first-order depth-induced disparity change scales as f*B*deltaZ/Z^2 in the stated local geometry; pure rotation does not use this depth-parallax term.
consumer_measures.visibility: Use a predeclared comparable static visible domain, report invalid/occluded coverage rather than filtering only successful predictions.
consumer_measures.actual_interface: Evaluate geometry after the existing VMem alignment before claiming its consumer is affected. Actual selected sources/visibility or coverage shifts remain distinct from generated-image quality.
consumer_measures.ground_truth_boundary: GT-derived scoring and diagnosis are post-seal evaluation only, not legal online gate features.

stop_rule: After one complete unchanged-natural-sequence screen, absent meaningful persistent event, only recovered isolated spikes, uncertainty/invalidity, or already-solved strong-baseline condition means stop S/M mechanism experiments on this segment. A different natural condition may be selected under a new fixed rule; added noise remains a separate synthetic stress test, not a manufactured natural discovery.
